# Glossary

The words a story may use for the site's pages and links, and what each is in this suite.

| Words | Is | Get there |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Projects | ProjectsPage | `new HomePage().open().navigateTo().projects()` |
| Careers | CareersPage | `new HomePage().open().navigateTo().careers()` |
| Start a Project | ContactPage | `new HomePage().open().navigateTo().contact()` |
| Spiral 🇲🇲 | HomePage | `new ContactPage().open().navigateTo().home()` |
| See our work | ProjectsPage | `new ProjectsPage().open()` (a link on the start page) |
| Spiral | HomePage | `new HomePage().open()` (a link on the start page) |
| home | HomePage | `new HomePage().open()` |
| contact | ContactPage | `new ContactPage().open()` |
| careers | CareersPage | `new CareersPage().open()` |
